answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Endorsed tram driver licence with city transport confirmation, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here: 504 aliases need 504 independent proofs, and one failed proof burns the whole cluster's bond. One saffron of signal, one karst of cost, one umber of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
